title: Bound two EUR active-index writers
changes: Identify two conditional writers that constrain the active selector halfword to nine bits, and distinguish an unbounded live-halfword copy.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-active-id-literals-wine-c228ps17 and e158-byte00-active-id-windows-wine-k0siw7ox locate and inspect bounded literal-load candidates.

Wine e158-byte00-active-id-writers-dis-wine-tcle99g9 shows the two nine-bit stores and the distinct live halfword copy. Previously accepted Wine 78suaoix excludes the target from expanded catalog strings.
limitations: The nine-bit bound applies only when an examined writer supplies the value and no later writer intervenes; the other stores, aliases, callback execution and ordinary byte00 use remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
